title: Tomato mince meat
notes: You may add anything else that is put in regular mince meat, fruit juices of any kind and if not sweet enough, add to suit your taste, or more spices. The tomatoes and apples are the base to work on

steps: 1 pk green tomatoes, grind pour boiling water over them and let cook for 15 or 20 min, drain and add the following.
1 pk apples, grind and save any juice.
Cook until done and seal while hot.
